subject: Learning Methods
title: Voice Notes and Recordings
description: One-minute skill: Voice Notes and Recordings.

hook.text: He recorded every lecture and never listened to them again. Thirty hours of audio sat untouched on his phone.

buildup.text: Audio recordings capture everything but provide no encoding benefit. Listening to an hour of audio takes an hour.

discovery.text: The value of recording is as backup, not replacement. Record for safety, but take notes during the session as primary.

twist.text: AI transcription changes the equation. Automatic transcripts can be searched, summarized, and processed much faster.

climax.text: Record and transcribe as a backup. Take active notes as your primary learning tool. Use both, not one alone.

punchline.text: Record for backup. Notes for learning. Both, not either.

quiz.question: Why are audio recordings alone a poor study tool?
options: Audio quality is usually too poor to understand
They provide no encoding benefit and take real-time to review
Most devices cannot store enough audio
